description: U-Net forecasting the probability of at least one VIIRS fire detection per 0.25 deg cell of Brazil for each of the next 7 days.
trained_with: notebooks/fire_forecast_base.py at commit 2f80945 (REGION brazil, VIIRS only)
si_assisted: Training code written with Claude (Anthropic) and reviewed by the Space Monkeys team; the model itself was trained by the team in Google Colab on NASA FIRMS data.
data: NASA FIRMS VIIRS S-NPP 375 m yearly archive, Brazil, type 0 (presumed vegetation fire), confidence nominal/high

inputs.counts: daily fire-pixel counts per cell by UTC acquisition date, uncapped
channels: log1p(count) for days t-6 .. t (7 channels)

outputs: logits for days t+1 .. t+7; probability = sigmoid(logit)

persistence.description: P(VIIRS fire j days after a VIIRS fire in the same cell), forecast cells, 2012-2022; computed by scripts/persistence_table.py and used by the GOES real-time anchor
